literal: Duality's nature having known, here virtue those who undertook, [their] greatness shines forth [in the] world.
translation: The greatness of those who have understood the nature of duality and embraced virtue here, shines forth in the world.
modern: நன்மை தீமை போன்ற இருமைகளின் தன்மையை ஆராய்ந்து அறிந்து, இவ்வுலகில் அறநெறியை உறுதியாக மேற்கொண்டவர்களின் பெருமையே உலகத்தில் சிறந்து விளங்கும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme greatness of those who commit themselves to a life of virtue. The word 'இருமை' (duality) refers to the contrasting pairs of existence, such as good and evil, or this world and the next. By fully understanding the nature of these dualities, wise individuals choose to firmly embrace 'அறம்' (virtue) while living 'ஈண்டு' (here in this world). Because of this profound clarity and steadfast commitment, their greatness stands out and shines brightly across the world.
